LAWS OF Arbitration CAP. 03.02 3
MONTSERRAT
Revision Date: 1 Jan 2002
CHAPTER 3.02
ARBITRATION ACT
(Acts 11 of 1907 and 24 of 1956)
Commencement
[1 October 1907]
Short title
1. This Act may be cited as the Arbitration Act.
Imperial Arbitration Act to apply to Montserrat
2. The Arbitration Act, 1889 (52 & 53 Vict. c. 49) of the Imperial
Parliament, shall be and the same is hereby declared to be henceforth in
force in Montserrat, and all the provisions of the said Act, so far as the
same are applicable, shall mutatis mutandis apply to all proceedings
relating to arbitration within Montserrat.
___________

LAWS OF Arbitration CAP. 03.02 5
MONTSERRAT
Revision Date: 1 Jan 2002 [Related Legislation]
CHAPTER 3.02
ARBITRATION (FOREIGN AWARDS) ACT
(Acts 4 of 1931, 2 of 1934 and S.R.O. 15/1956)
Commencement
[7 May 1931]
Short title
1. This Act may be cited as the Arbitration (Foreign Awards) Act.
Imperial Arbitration Acts to apply to Montserrat
2. The Arbitration Clauses (Protocol) Act, 1924 (14 and 15 George 5,
Chapter 39) and the Arbitration (Foreign Awards) Act, 1930 (20 George 5,
Chapter 15) of the Imperial Parliament, shall be and the same are hereby
declared to be henceforth in force in Montserrat, and all the provisions of
the said Acts, shall apply to all proceedings relating to arbitration within
Montserrat.
Application to Montserrat
3. In the application of Part 1 of the Arbitration (Foreign Awards) Act,
1930, (20 Geo. V Cap. 15) to Montserrat the following modifications shall
be made—
(a) for the reference to England there shall be substituted
reference to Montserrat;
(b) the following shall be substituted for subsection (3) of
section 4:
“(3) Subject to the provisions of this section, the
High Court shall have power to make Rules of Court with
respect to the evidence which must be furnished by a party
seeking to enforce an award under this Part of this Act.”.
